description: Routing accuracy corpus — phrases that should/should not activate report-state. Adversarial cases discriminate it from siblings, especially report-progress (current-state snapshot vs project task status), the hard routing boundary flagged in the 2026-05-31 review.
trigger_phrases: current state report on our systems
situation report — where do we stand
baseline the platform before the migration
what's the state of things across the portfolio
assess our current capabilities with a health matrix
system health check with RAG and trend
portfolio review — what's healthy and what isn't
comprehensive current-state snapshot with health signals
neutral baseline of the system's current conditions
state of X — what exists, what works, what's trending
adversarial_phrases: weekly project status with blockers, milestones, and next steps
how are we doing on project X this week
write a strategic report with glossary and recommendations
intel brief with BLUF and confidence levels
get me up to speed on this topic quickly
write the PRD for this feature
notes: Adversarials route to siblings: project/sprint/blockers/milestones/this-week → report-progress (the closest, scope-narrow sibling); strategic/glossary/recommendations → report-strategic; BLUF/confidence/get-up-to-speed → report-brief; PRD → plan-prd. report-state owns the broad current-state snapshot (inventory + health matrix + trajectory + gaps), not a single project's task status.
